verdict.rationale: Wise documents an API for making business payments programmatically (wise-docs-6) and an llms.txt referencing a 'Global Payments API' (wise-probe-1), suggesting some headless/automation capability exists. However, no OpenAPI/swagger spec is discoverable at standard locations (wise-probe-2 shows 404s), and there is no explicit mention of CI integration, SDKs, webhooks, or automation-friendly tooling. Missing for 10: discoverable API spec, CI/CD examples, SDK/CLI tooling, and any explicit automation-focused documentation.
